components.text:
The Ritual of the Shepherd (internally: Ritual of Animal Growth) speeds up the growth of baby animals and encourages breeding in a radius around the Master Ritual Stone. Tier 0, costs $(blood)10,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.

Various Demon Will types can be channeled into this ritual via the Aura to change its behavior - for example, feeding it Steadfast Will lets it draw breeding feed from a linked chest instead of requiring animals to already be in love mode. Check the ritual's tooltip in-game (via the Ritual Diviner or a Divination Sigil) for the exact current bonuses on this branch.
